Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper operation
and calibration of the relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on
an annually bases. The
document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing
personal injury or damage to equipment.
The first draft initiated by eng.
Abdel Raheem Salem Mohamed Ez,
tested by eng. Khaled El-Etreby & eng. Atef Farh, revised by 
quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo., and approved by eng. Monear Mahmoud El-Wakeel: Head Sector of Damietta Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
 safety category,
Safety fence
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
A work permit
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
 safety category,
CB and the equipment off i.e. out
 of service,
Isolated trip sequel for distribute base bar
Tools and Equipment
Test set Siemens type 7VP48 & 7VP49
Screw driver
Work to be Carried Out
Ensure that the CB and 
 its equipment out of service.
Ensure that the BF trip
 for BB was isolated.
Remove the plugs of
 matrix for t 2 (BB equipment in service
 which locate in the same bay)
Check equipment of that
 breaker must be out of service.
Connect the current
 leads to
 Breaker on BB1 X11 (12,14) & (22,24) & (32,34)
 Breaker on BBII X12 (12,14) & (22,24) & (32,34)
 Breaker coupler X13 (12,14) & (22,24) & (32,34)
Increase the current
 value until lamp light then record the (Ipu) and then decrease the 
 current until lamp distinguished then record (Id.o)
Inject the pick up
 value of current while the trip signal points:
 X (11 or 12 or 13) (702,712) or (703,713) are bridged for breaker which be tested C.B.X BB1 X11., C.B.X BBII X12, C.B.X Bus coupler X13
Trip signal from B.F 
 t1, t2 are status. Make abridge between CB auxiliary contact closed (701,711) 
 while the trip signal points (702,712) or (703,713) are bridged also.
In each case of steps 
 8, 9 
 we notice the lamps t1, t2 are light and record the phoenix relay which is 
 energized, measure the operating time from free contact.
Putt t2 to setting 
 infinity then close the CB without isolators and repeat the pervious steps 
 7, 8
